description: Pin a doc, presentation or storyboard to its space, so every chat in the space and its sub-spaces reads it: brand rules, a brief, a source the work must rest on. A doc still in its task chat is added to that chat's space first. A pin is team material: when it would share a private doc with the team or turn its reuse back on, this is refused; ask your human, then call again with share: true.

doc_id.description: A doc id from get_task or list_space.

share.description: true only once your human agreed to what the refusal named.

name: pin
title: Pin doc
